projects.title: Aurora Commerce
projects.description: A headless storefront with fluid page transitions and a sub-second checkout flow.
projects.content: Aurora is a headless commerce experience built for a fashion label that wanted the feel of an editorial magazine without sacrificing conversion. The storefront is statically rendered with on-demand revalidation, product imagery is streamed progressively, and every navigation is choreographed with shared-element transitions. The result was a 38% lift in mobile conversion and a Lighthouse performance score that never dips below 98.

projects.title: Pulse Analytics
projects.description: A real-time analytics dashboard rendering millions of data points at 60fps.
projects.content: Pulse is an internal analytics tool for a logistics company tracking fleets across Europe. Traditional SVG charts collapsed under the data volume, so the rendering layer was rewritten on top of WebGL with a custom instanced point renderer. Filters, brushing and zooming all happen on the GPU, keeping interactions smooth even on mid-range laptops.

image.alt: Analytics dashboard with charts on a laptop screen

projects.title: Lumen Studio
projects.description: An immersive portfolio for an architecture studio, driven by custom shaders.
projects.content: Lumen Studio needed a site that felt like walking through one of their buildings. Each project is presented as a light study: a custom GLSL shader reacts to scroll position and pointer movement, casting soft shadows across typography. Despite the visual ambition, the site ships under 150kb of JavaScript on first load.

projects.title: Terminal Notes
projects.description: A keyboard-first note taking app for developers, with local-first sync.
projects.content: Terminal Notes started as a weekend project and grew into a tool used by a few thousand developers. Notes are stored locally in SQLite and synced through a CRDT layer, so it works offline and merges conflicts automatically. Every action is reachable from the keyboard through a fuzzy command palette.
